name: Skyward Group
verdict: The unified holding-company brand of Nasdaq-listed US specialty insurer Skyward Specialty Insurance Group (SKWD). Nothing found.
note: Exclusive Insurance Partner and Official Front-of-Jersey sponsor of all USA Rugby national teams, announced 2026-04-08 (multi-year). Previous front-of-jersey sponsor Wasabi Technologies covered summer to late 2025. Rated none: the owner's 2026 proxy lists only US investment managers (BlackRock, Reinhart Partners, Vanguard, Capital International) and company director James Hays at 5% or more; no state or state fund appears.
